system.description: A fortified hideout with twisting corridors and layers of defenses
system.notes:
Standard | Exploration

A fortified hideout with twisting corridors and layers of defenses
Impulses: Slow intruders down, exhaust, strike, trap them inside

Difficulty: 15

Features

Unsafe - Passive: Any action or feature used to recover HP or Stress costs a Hope to use. If it already costs Hope, it requires one extra.

Villain's Office - Passive: A PC can investigate the stronghold’s war table, maps, or notes and make a Wits Roll to learn information about the villain’s operations, supply routes, or next planned strike.

Grand Hall - Passive: PCs who make a successful Instinct or Wits Roll can spot a way to use the environment - toppling a table, cutting a chandelier, or overturning a cauldron - dealing 2d8 physical damage to enemies within Close of a chosen point..

Hidden Vault - Passive: PCs who search carefully can make a Wits or Instinct Roll to find a hidden vault of goods and gear.

Barracks - Passive: If the alarm has been raised, this room is full of hostile NPCs preparing to join the fight. PCs who sneak through undetected can sabotage weapons or prevent reinforcements.

Escape Tunnel - Passive: PCs who investigate carefully can discover a concealed exit from the stronghold. On a success, they find the route; on a critical success, they learn where it leads.

Booby-Trapped Hallways - Action: All targets within Close range of a chosen point must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or take 1d10+2 physical damage.

Rallying Cry - Action: Once per scene, roll a d4. Each ally of the villain within Far range of them clears HP and Stress equal to the result. The villain can decide how to split the result for each ally.

Reinforcements - Action: Spend a Fear to summon 1d6 of the villain's forces of various types, who arrive within Close.
